title: Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Down-Payment Share for TRAC Deficiency Arrangements
content:
# Rate Schedule — Down-Payment Share on a TRAC Deficiency Arrangement, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

**Schedule.** For a Kestrel payment arrangement on a TRAC deficiency of a Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease unit, the down-payment share is 10 percent where the unit had been in service 24 or more whole months when it was turned in, 20 percent where it had been in service 12 to 23 whole months, and 100 percent where it had been in service fewer than 12 whole months.

**Counting.** Whole months run from the unit's in-service date to its turn-in date and are one fewer where the turn-in date's day of the month is smaller than the in-service date's.

| Whole months in service at turn-in | Down-payment share |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | 10 percent |
| 12 to 23 | 20 percent |
| fewer than 12 | 100 percent |

## Edges (hypothetical, in service on the 12th of a month)

| Turned in on | Whole months | Share |
|---|---|---|
| the 11th of the month 24 months later | 23 | 20 percent |
| the 12th of that month | 24 | 10 percent |
| the 11th of the month 12 months later | 11 | 100 percent |
| the 12th of that month | 12 | 20 percent |
